chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Uniforms, road managers and valets
summary: McRae lists the road manager and valets, buying suits at Young and Taylor, and the clothes changes with Chick versus Cab Calloway.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, back when you were with Chick's band and you were straw boss and you were musical director and so forth, were there any difficulties -- particular difficulties that you had with musicians? What about also getting the band uniforms cleaned? Were you responsible for that?
We were responsible for -- No. That -- I was responsible for everything in a way, but with that we gave to -- we had like two --
Road manager, two valets.

Had two valets, yeah. We had a road manager and a valet. See, everything was written out. You write everything out what's supposed to be done. You had it out to -- Like if I wanted the uniforms cleaned, the guy come to me and say, "We ought to clean these
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
uniforms." Chick would get together with me -- Young and Taylor, we used to buy our clothes from there.
Young and Taylor?
Yeah, you know, 48th Street and Broadway. That big fancy store that sell all the high priced clothes.
At that time, clothes wasn't that high. We used to go in there -- We used to buy all our top suits from there. Everything was fancy about --
What was the material for the suits?
The very best. The very best. Those white coats (inaudible), they were the very best. We didn't wear no cheap clothes. Never.
All the suits that Louie wore were from two hundred and fifty dollars to three hundred dollars. They were all made by a special tailor.
Glaser had his suits made from this
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
tailor at 49th and 7th Avenue upstairs. Made all the band suits. Made Duke's suits. They turn out the whole band. Everybody had to go there for a fitting.
You mentioned with Chick's band, that you have sometimes four different changes of uniform in one evening?

Yeah. We would have to. With Chick, we had like three changes or changes. We would like wear a sport outfit maybe for two shows. Myabe we wear the tuxedos for the supper show. Then we'd come back with a solid suit for the last show -- the last two shows, or something like that. But with Cab Calloway, we had to change every show. We had to change -- sport outfit, and then we wear a brown coat, you know, (inaudible) and brown pants what we have to wear. We have on maybe a gray and brown, or some pants like that. Some offset of what he's

wearing.
He bought all the clothes. He had to pay for all the uniforms. Had tails, we had tuxedos, we had sport outfits, and a couple of other -- maybe other solid suits, you know.
And they bought them with the shirts where they could, you know --
